not scored preflight/stage/2/timestamps/monotonicity/live_path — observed through a RecordedSource loading the native recording format, recv-time
monotonicity is enforced upstream by load_recording, which rejects non-monotonic
recv-times, so the property cannot fail here; a LiveSource or a RecordedSource 
wrapping a rosbag2 .mcap bag (E3-DC/E3-FL) instead scores this quantity directly
from the bag's own receipt order — this disclosure fires only when no such 
capture was loaded, expected monotonic receive-times verified on the live path
  action: load a live or .mcap-bag capture to score live-path monotonicity 
directly; RecordedSource-native monotonicity remains enforced at load_recording

  action: score wall-clock currency only through an exercised LiveSource
